newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tenaga to up efficiency with restructure.
newsitem.headline: Tenaga to up efficiency with restructure.

text.p: Malaysian power giant Tenaga Nasional Bhd will raise its efficiency at the end of an ongoing restructuring to divide its three core activities, company executive chairman Ahmad Tajuddin Ali said on Monday.
He was quoted as saying by the national Bernama news agency that the exercise would ensure the delivery of electricity to consumers at minimum cost.

"What I'm trying to do is to enhance the efficiency of our own administration and management. At the end of the day, we must improve our own management efficiency such that we can deliver the electricity to consumers at the minimum cost," he told reporters after a Tenaga function.

He was commenting on an earlier remark by Energy, Telecommunications and Posts Minister Leo Moggie that Tenaga is implementing a restructuring plan to divide its generation, transmission and distribution activities.
Tajuddin said daily operations of the three activities would be handled by three different groups with its own chief executive.
But Tajuddin said he would still be responsible for the main operations of these entities.
